feeds.title: The Porchlight Project Blog
feeds.description: The Porchlight Project was formed to lend special help to cases of abduction and murder that have gone cold.It provides free private investigative services, funding for DNA testing, and media support for a few new cases every year. Read exclusive spotlights on selected cold cases in the blog.

feeds.title: Cold Case Inc. Blog
feeds.description: Cold Case Inc, a visionary venture by Billy Cross, is rapidly reshaping the landscape of online detective gaming and unsolved case files. Join the team at Cold Case Inc, where every click unravels a mystery and every player is a step closer to solving the grand enigma of the digital age.

feeds.title: Cold Case Christianity
feeds.description: Cold Case Christianity by J. Warner Wallace. J. Warner Wallace is a Dateline featured cold-case homicide detective, popular national speaker and best-selling author. He continues to consult on cold-case investigations while serving as a Senior Fellow at the Colson Center for Christian Worldview.

feeds.title: Stories of the Unsolved
feeds.description: Stories of the Unsolved is examining the world of solved and unsolved cases. Stories of the Unsolved is a website born out of two passions: writing and true crime. Since its launch in 2018, it has evolved into a place where work is done to raise awareness about unsolved cases, primarily murders and disappearances, in the hopes of helping the families of those involved find some closure.

feeds.title: Bonnie's Blog of Crime
feeds.description: This blog is crime related, mostly concerning violent crime, especially murder or sex crimes. My focus is mostly on the victim and on justice. The victim needs to be always the center and focus of justice. Bonnie's Blog of Crime shares posts about Crime, Murder, Missing People, Cold Cases, Death Row and Fugitives.

feeds.title: Defrosting Cold Cases
feeds.description: Defrosting Cold Cases is a website with information about unsolved homicides, the missing and the unidentified, wrongful convictions, and book reviews. On here, you'll find articles about old, unsolved cases from the pre-DNA era. They need renewed media attention. The active investigations of these cases is left to professionals.

feeds.title: Project Cold Case
feeds.description: Project Cold Case is a nonprofit blog focused on raising awareness about unsolved homicide cases in the United States. It shares victim stories, maintains a public database of cold cases, and supports families seeking justice through advocacy and storytelling.

feeds.title: Cold Case Initiative News
feeds.description: Read chilling Cold Case news stories and breakthrough updates. Cold Case Initiative is a non-profit that assists agencies in the United States by providing funding to offset the cost of scientific and investigative techniques being used to solve cold-case homicides and violent crimes, identify missing persons, and give names back to unidentified decedents.

feeds.title: Kill Zone Blog » Cold Case
feeds.description: In this Cold Cases archive, you'll uncover the gritty details surrounding puzzling disappearances, brutal murders, and baffling crimes that have eluded resolution for decades. The Kill Zone is the home of 11 top suspense writers and publishing professionals. It covers the publishing biz, marketing how-to's, and the craft of writing.

feeds.title: Cold Case Kansas
feeds.description: Delve into the abyss of unsolved crimes that have left families shattered and communities forever changed. Cold Case Kansas's blog unravels the haunting details, evidence, and theories surrounding the most perplexing mysteries and heinous acts that continue to defy resolution.

feeds.title: Fairfax County Police Department News » Cold Case
feeds.description: Within this archive, you will find a comprehensive collection of unsolved crimes and baffling mysteries that continue to evade resolution after years or even decades. Fairfax County Police Department Cold Case Files provide in-depth analysis, official case details, documented evidence, and the latest updates on investigations various crimes.

feeds.title: Uncovered
feeds.description: Uncovered is a software platform that combines data, analytics, and the wisdom of the community to help solve the cold cases of murdered or missing people. Read case studies, crime show reviews, family stories, and other investigative updates in this feed.
